mintAuthority.summary: IUSD receipt-token minting is gated by RECEIPT_TOKEN_MINTER in the infiniFi Core. Four protocol contracts hold the native role; the fifth current role holder, OutlandVault, is cross-chain portal reconciliation machinery assessed in Bridge Risk. Only YieldSharing is upgradeable. Mint-role administration, ReceiptToken core replacement, and YieldSharing upgrades all require the 4-of-8 admin Safe to schedule an action through a seven-day timelock.

controls.label: infiniFi MintController
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25771089, Core role enumeration returned MintController 0x49877d937b9a00d50557bdc3d87287b5c3a4c256 as a RECEIPT_TOKEN_MINTER. It is a direct non-proxy deployment and remains a native collateral/accounting minter.

controls.label: infiniFi mint path proxy (TransparentUpgradeableProxy)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25771089, Core role enumeration returned YieldSharing proxy 0x90e91f5bfd9a0a4d925bf30b512add8cd2bbae3b as a RECEIPT_TOKEN_MINTER. Its ProxyAdmin is owned by the seven-day infiniFi Timelock, and this is a native protocol mint path.

controls.label: infiniFi PLSmoother
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25771089, Core role enumeration returned PLSmoother 0xc324569141697045b9ede54b5d4623a691ed57a4 as a RECEIPT_TOKEN_MINTER. It is a direct non-proxy deployment and remains a native protocol mint path.

controls.label: infiniFi MigrationController
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25771089, Core role enumeration returned MigrationController 0x5f5403656e4db95accf1064a714b1bce351839f8 as a RECEIPT_TOKEN_MINTER. It is a direct non-proxy deployment and remains a native migration/accounting mint path.

controls.label: infiniFi admin Safe (PROPOSER_ROLE + MINOR_ROLES_MANAGER)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25771089, RECEIPT_TOKEN_MINTER's admin was GOVERNOR. Safe 0x80608f852d152024c0a2087b16939235fec2400c had MINOR_ROLES_MANAGER but not GOVERNOR; direct Safe grantRole/revokeRole calls reverted requiring GOVERNOR, and ReceiptToken.setCore reverted UNAUTHORIZED. Timelock 0x3d18480cc32b6ab3b833dcabd80e76cfd41c48a9 held GOVERNOR, had getMinDelay() = 604800, and the current 4-of-8 Safe was its sole proposer. Core role enumeration listed the four native protocol minters plus OutlandVault 0xf0d0f1fdee5595628de17b37e4134a5bac4441c3; OutlandVault's portal reconciliation is bridge machinery and is therefore excluded from native Mint Authority scoring. YieldSharing ProxyAdmin 0x094227ee5e9c3877860ac212f1e5218441e5b4eb was owned by that Timelock; a direct Safe upgrade call reverted as unauthorized.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25771089, ReceiptToken 0x48f9e38f3070ad8945dfeae3fa70987722e3d89c, Core 0xf6d48735eccf12bdc1df2674b1ce3fcb3bd25490, MintController 0x49877d937b9a00d50557bdc3d87287b5c3a4c256, PLSmoother 0xc324569141697045b9ede54b5d4623a691ed57a4, and MigrationController 0x5f5403656e4db95accf1064a714b1bce351839f8 were direct non-proxy deployments. Core also listed OutlandVault 0xf0d0f1fdee5595628de17b37e4134a5bac4441c3 as a fifth RECEIPT_TOKEN_MINTER; its portal reconciliation can mirror remote supply and is authored in Bridge Risk, not counted as native Mint Authority. YieldSharing 0x90e91f5bfd9a0a4d925bf30b512add8cd2bbae3b was a transparent proxy with implementation 0x0d5dbf208a9a7540018d204a9a0ad08a091407e5 and ProxyAdmin 0x094227ee5e9c3877860ac212f1e5218441e5b4eb. The current 4-of-8 admin Safe has no immediate GOVERNOR or ProxyAdmin-owner path: mint-role administration, ReceiptToken core replacement, and YieldSharing upgrades all converge on Timelock 0x3d18480cc32b6ab3b833dcabd80e76cfd41c48a9 with a 604800-second minimum delay. IUSD native issuance remains receipt-token issuance through the four protocol minters and is separate from the BNB, Tempo, and Outland bridge machinery; every path to replace the receipt core, add a minter, or change the upgradeable mint module traverses that seven-day delay, so economic cap semantics remain raiseable rather than unbounded. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-16: the seven-day timelock bounds mint-path changes, the real-time protocol feed covers the full reserve composition, and no regulator or independent attestor is evidenced.
